saved mask comes from /tmp/run.py (written in C10, rerun in C12 in the working directory), which reads the 60x60 region subset cached in C7. That script builds hazen 90th-percentile thresholds from ±5-day pools and smooths them with a 31-day wrap-around mean; only smoothed days 153–244 are indexed, so the pooled thresholds for doy 138–259 (calendar 12 May–20 Sep in each baseline year) are used. It then compares every sea cell's 2005-06-01..2005-08-31 SST against those thresholds and forms per-cell runs that are joined across 1–2 day gaps."}
